source_observations.notes:
A semi-rare item. Because of its heavy use in obtaining addons as well as its low drop rate, spider silks have a good market value. However, this is declining with the introduction of many new areas with [[Giant Spider]]s and [[Crystal Spider]]s. Low levels can and often do complete the [[Tarantula]] task of [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]] to get a high chance of looting one from the boss, [[Hide]]. Due to a (now fixed) game bug that allowed people to kill an unlimited number of task bosses using field runes, spider silks were heavily inflated even on [[Aurora]] and [[Aurera]] where [[World Transfer]] is forbidden.
It looks the same as [[Recharging Tarantula Trap]] and [[Steel Spider Silk]], which is also often used to scamming people through trade.

source_observations.notes: Death rings were once one of the oldest items in [[Tibia]]. It was replaced in an [[update]] by [[Stealth Ring]]s at the same time the other magical [[ring]]s were introduced. It reduces your [[shielding]] by 10 points and has energy for 7 minutes 30 seconds. Quite valued on the market nowadays since they can be used as quest items and useful in wars because of its death protection. Using a death ring when your shield skill is originally 10, it is reduced down to 0. It's also worth mentioning that even though shield is reduced by 10 levels, '''your shielding skill won't go up faster'''. The value of the ring decreased after [[Updates/8.10|Christmas Update 2007]] because since then it is obtainable from quests. The attributes are only shown when worn.

source_observations.notes: It cures your [[Poisoned]] state when you click on it while wearing it, you can use it once every 10~ seconds. When you move it to your ring slot, you will receive 200 damage (will be less if wearing equipment), but if you do it while standing in a protection zone you won't take any damage, once you've put it on you don't have to take it off for it to recharge. When it depletes for one day, you might get [[Poisoned]] or [[Cursed]]. When you get cursed, you'll get the following message: {{Server Message|You are cursed by The Noxious Spawn!}}. If it happens you receive around 15 turns of damage, increasing from 1 until the last damage of 662+ (remove the curse eating a [[Hydra Tongue Salad]] or asking for healing in a temple). When it happens, the message about the claw being usable only for levels 100+ disappears and the claw can't be put in ring slot (becomes a decoration object). It recharges in about 24 hours. Note that the 24 hour recovery time counts down only when the item is "active" i.e. it will not count down in your depot unless you stand on the depot tile, nor will it recover in your inventory if you are offline; keeping it in a house is the better option as it will take the least amount of time. You could also carry 2 or more claws and switch when one depletes.
